title: [ALL] Generic Service Dashboard (Don't Edit)
description:
## Generic G2 Dashboard

This dashboard can be used to get health insight into a G2 microservice at Toast. This should be useful for determining the health of a service, debugging production events, and monitoring it during elevations. 

This dashboard takes advantage of common dropwizard, jvm, and docker metrics that are published consistently by all services. 

**I don't recommend cloning this dashboard.** Instead create a saved view and filter to your service. Our metrics are constantly changing and we frequently tweak this board to better monitor the health of our services.

definition.title: Total requests rate by service/version (Red Bar=Elevation)
5xx Response Count and gRPC Server Errors

queries.query: sum:grpc.server.processing.duration.count{$toast_env AND $revision AND $service AND (statuscode:internal OR statuscode:unknown)} by {toast_service_name,toast_service_revision,toast_deployment}.as_count()
queries.name: query3

queries.query: sum:envoy.cluster.upstream_rq_xx{toast_environment:prod AND envoy_type:sidecar AND (envoy.response_code_class:5) AND NOT envoy.cluster_name:local* AND NOT envoy.cluster_name:ingress* AND $envoy_cluster_name} by {envoy.response_code_class,toast_service_name,toast_service_revision,toast_deployment,envoy.cluster_name}.as_count()
queries.name: query4

queries.query: sum:grpc.server.processing.duration.count{$toast_env AND $revision AND $service AND (statuscode:internal OR statuscode:unknown) AND $host} by {toast_service_name,toast_service_revision,toast_deployment,host,cluster_name}.as_count()
